result.title: Dual Architecture Fusion Vehicle Lidar 3D Target Detection
result.summary: In this paper, a 3D backbone network (SpconvTransformer) based on the fusion of convolutional architecture branch and Transformer architecture branch is proposed. The convolution branch uses 3D sparse convolution and submanifold convolution to learn local voxel features and semantic information, and the Transformer branch uses the self-attention mechanism to model the remote relationship between voxels, uses the broad receptive field to capture rich context information, and complementing the advantages of the two architectures by fusing the local features extracted from the two branches and the global features solves the problem of limited receptive fields of 3D convolutional neural networks. The experimental results show that the average accuracy of SpconvTransformer in 3D object detection and bird's-eye view detection tasks reaches 81.45% and 88.09%, respectively, and the average directional similarity reaches 91.10%, which is significantly better than other existing algorithms.

AI.brief_summary: 提出融合 3D 稀疏卷积与 Transformer 自注意力的 SpconvTransformer 骨干，用于 LiDAR 点云 3D 与鸟瞰图目标检测。
AI.relevance_reason: 属自动驾驶点云检测的架构改进，虽涉及感受野与局部/全局特征融合，但未涉及视觉语言推理状态、证据筛选、停止决策或 latent 生成，与 LVR 主线缺少可迁移的具体线索。
